in_sanskrit.name: निशीथ
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: one who stays awake at night

in_marathi.name: Nishith
in_marathi.long_meaning: Nishith हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Rooted in Sanskrit, Nishith means 'Intellect' or 'Understanding'. Derived from the Sanskrit root 'nish' meaning 'to remain' or 'to stay', Nishith signifies one who has a deep understanding and is rooted in knowledge.
